authority: Preparation only; all prior allowances are consumed. Sending these payloads to AWS requires a new explicit 76-call approval.
factor: Same complete isolated business input, response contract, schema, model and settings. Only shared citation-purpose guidance differs. Retained baseline edit/request files exactly match native-scope candidate files; new control uses the frozen pre-edit prompt through the same current builder.

limits.usage_stop_semantics: Check actual cumulative usage after every completed exchange; at or above threshold send no further trial. A single in-flight completion may cross the threshold. This is an experiment spending stop, not a runtime reservation or provider token ceiling. No dollar cap is asserted.

quality_gate.scope: New same-contract prompt-only study. Historical native-scope gates and scores are untouched; old two-attribution-gain threshold concerned removal of returned members and is not the hypothesis here.
quality_gate.citation_benefit: Claim observed citation improvement only if candidate has more complete AND relevant physical assessments than concurrent baseline, with all safety gates passing. Perfect arms establish nonregression, not superiority.
quality_gate.cost_gate: Known actual input/output usage for every completed call; stop at frozen 300000-token spending limit, unknown usage or uncertainty. Report call count, token/latency per physical assessment and complete decision and paired ratios. No fabricated dollar cap or model token ceiling.
quality_gate.gate_failure: No handoff or E2E qualification claim, no automatic retries or extra calls. Retain defects and unresolved comparison outcome.

cases.missing_obligation: When started, the application must display Hello, World!.
When an eligible borrower requests renewal of a loan with no reservation, the service must extend its due date by seven days.
When the reservoir falls below the minimum, the pump must stop and remain stopped until the level recovers.
After the chamber door closes, the fan may restart only when the operator confirms readiness.
Parcel release requires both recipient identity verification and payment confirmation.
After an appointment is cancelled, the service must notify the patient.
During power loss, the cabinet must keep medicine cold for eight hours, and an alarm must sound if backup cooling fails.
Ending a parking session requires settled payment; failed payment must leave the session active.
When started, the application must display Hello, World!.
MOCK The access door must not unlock while the sterilizer is pressurized.
MOCK Voucher release requires manager approval as well as cleared payment.
MOCK After inspection is approved, show MOCK Ready to the inspector.
When smoke is detected, the controller must sound the alarm and must keep the exit door unlocked while smoke persists.

captured-description.notes: Startup greeting; title/headings/date-time lines do not establish it. Span 5–6 is acceptable if explanation uses the startup context; unrelated padding is scored separately.

loan-candidate.notes: Eligibility, no reservation, seven-day extension on request; conditional duty is not an invented only-if prohibition.

extraction-inherited.notes: Pump stop below minimum and until recovery; display/measurement lines cannot replace it.

fan-direct-signal.notes: Door closes and operator readiness confirmation; explain preservation in assigned original claims rather than deficient signal context.

joint-two-sources.notes: Both identity verification and payment are necessary to the complete obligation.

wrong-role-assignment.notes: Cancellation must trigger patient notification; clinic hours are unrelated.

unresolved-multiple-producers.notes: Captured alarm citation failure: cite cooling duration/power-loss and alarm/backup-failure parts even for lost verdict. Ownership remains unresolved.

parking-candidate.notes: Settled payment required to end; failed payment leaves active. Both clauses and obligation strength matter.

captured-story.notes: Startup greeting; complete behavior survives both collections.

sterile-door.notes: No unlocking under pressure; equivalent staying-locked wording allowed.

voucher-release.notes: Each assessment must support manager approval plus cleared payment. Historical assembled evidence rules remain unchanged in historical panels; this new guidance study explicitly scores each isolated assessment.

dual-ready.notes: Inspection-triggered display to inspector uses source2 occurrence; same text for payer/payment in source1 is unrelated and must not be cited as support.

smoke-exit-compound.notes: One span 1–2 or two spans 1,2 support alarm-on-detection and unlocked exit while smoke persists. Calibration version in offered source2 must not be cited.

assessment.manual: Manual semantic assessment, unblinded, preferably two independent reviewers. Source/line IDs and nonblank explanation are mechanical checks, not semantic proof.
assessment.native: Both arms use the same current closed native-scope codec and original complete assignment; every child retains case/repetition/comparison/request hash and authentic replay response identity. No old-wire reader or ID fill.
assessment.citation_scoring: Assess union of returned spans for this one complete obligation in each assessment, separately from collection verdict and explanation. Relevant extra context is permitted when it explains a necessary condition; unrelated source or line padding fails relevance.
assessment.generalization: Twelve known regressions plus one newly prepared control; one model/settings pair and two repetitions do not demonstrate broad reliability.
assessment.handoff: Separate 30-review-call preparation; dynamic loss packets use only actual admitted source-review output, retained unchanged, and require later freezing/approval.
